title: Photo journaling
description: Styling and photographing small everyday moments, mostly around food and the seasons, and keeping them as a visual diary.

images.alt: A red mug of hot chocolate topped with a marshmallow snowman, next to meringue cookies and a gift wrapped in kraft paper on an orange knitted blanket.
Glaze being poured over a braided cinnamon bun, with a bowl of cinnamon sticks and a rolling pin on a white table.

title: Playful illustration & collection design
description: Cheerful hand-drawn characters with a pun, developed into small print collections under The_HanZz Studio.

images.alt: Four illustrated prints laid out on a desk: Coffee because adulting is hard, Coffee and friends make the perfect blend, Espresso yourself, and Tea is like a hug in a mug.
Framed yellow print of a smiling character holding a red mug, captioned Coffee, because adulting is hard.
Framed pink print of a character relaxing in a blue cup, captioned Tea is like a hug in a mug.
Framed purple print of a yellow polka-dot mug and a character offering a flower, captioned Caffeine and kindness go hand in hand.
Framed pink print of two characters in a green teapot, captioned Coffee and friends make the perfect blend, surrounded by plants and a camera.
Framed red print of characters in a teal cup and a croissant, captioned Bake and make with love.
Hand-drawn illustration of a red mug and a croissant high-fiving, captioned Croissant and coffee, happy tummy.
The HanZz Studio logo: a smiling character painting at an easel under a red striped awning.

title: Party games
description: Game nights with friends. Costumes are optional but strongly encouraged.

images.alt: Five friends dressed as sheet ghosts wearing sunglasses, sitting on a sofa under red party lighting.

title: Baking cookies & playing around with recipes
description: Cookie cut-outs, gingerbread people and the occasional recipe experiment that turns into a new favourite.

images.alt: Flat lay of cookie dough with star and heart cut-outs, decorated gingerbread cookies, eggs, candles and fir branches.
Rolling pin, cookie dough with cut-out shapes, gingerbread people and a Christmas tree cookie on a plate, with eggs and candles.
